subject: A question on mixed variables for the CFA model

messages.author: a8163a4fdf7c547d
messages.subject: A question on mixed variables for the CFA model
parts:
I want to build a model using CFA (LAVAAN), including uni factor model, Bi factor model and correlated factor model, but my variable list contains both categorical and continuous variables, in this case can I run the CFA model directly with lavaan?

Most of these variables are binary, so which kind of estimator I use is more appropriate

parts:
I am glad to see that you start this discussion and many friends join in to heat up this topic and make everyone have a better understanding of it..Dear [Name],

Thank you for your email regarding building a model using CFA (LAVAAN). To answer your question, yes, you can run a CFA model with LAVAAN using a combination of categorical and continuous variables. LAVAAN has the flexibility to handle both types of variables, and you can specify the measurement model accordingly.

Regarding the choice of estimator, since most of your variables are binary, it would be appropriate to use a robust estimator that is specifically designed for categorical variables, such as the Weighted Least Squares Mean and Variance adjusted (WLSMV) estimator or the robust Diagonally Weighted Least Squares (DWLS) estimator.

I hope this helps. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out.
Best regards,
liuhq
